D/ IMP CAE[S VES]PASIAN AVG COS VIII PP ; R/ [AEQVITAS] AVGVSTI SC

A Roman copper alloy coin: as of Vespasian dating AD74-5. Mint: Lugdunum (Lyon). RIC no. 842-3. Obverse: Laureate bust right, small globe below. Obverse inscription: IMP CAE[S VES]PASIAN AVG COS VIII PP. Reverse: Aequitas, draped, standing left, holding scales in right hand and long vertical rod (pertica) in left. Reverse inscription: [AEQVITAS] AVGVSTI SC left and right low in field. Die axis…
